messages.subject: Pinnacle House Floors 4-5 - schedule of condition
messages.plaintextBody:
Joanna,

Please could you finalise the photographic schedule of condition for Floors 4 and 5 so we can annex it to the lease (Schedule 6). The tenant's repairing liability will be limited by reference to it. We need it before exchange.

Elena
